configurations.name: Build Rust Sendspin (Windows Release)
configurations.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Set-Location ""${workspaceFolder}/rust/sendspin_bridge""; cargo build --release; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path ""${workspaceFolder}/windows/native"" -Force | Out-Null; Copy-Item ""${workspaceFolder}/rust/sendspin_bridge/target/release/mashin_sendspin_bridge.dll"" ""${workspaceFolder}/windows/native/mashin_sendspin_bridge.dll"" -Force"

configurations.name: Build Rust Sendspin (Android arm64-v8a Release)
configurations.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Set-Location ""${workspaceFolder}/rust/sendspin_bridge""; cargo ndk -t arm64-v8a -P 26 -o ""${workspaceFolder}/android/app/src/main/jniLibs"" build --release"
